Tiago Pereira is a Portuguese track and field athlete who specializes in the triple jump. Born on December 19, 1993, in Lisbon, Portugal, Pereira has represented Portugal in various international competitions. He has been recognized for his performances in events such as the European Athletics Championships and has been a key figure in Portuguese athletics, particularly in the horizontal jumps category.

Pereira's career includes participation in national and international track and field competitions, where he has consistently been one of the top Portuguese athletes in the triple jump discipline. He is known for his dedication to the sport and his contributions to Portuguese athletics at the competitive level. While not always in the global spotlight, he has achieved respectable results in European competitions and serves as an ambassador for athletics in Portugal.
